Grace Ling connected API keys to Claude Cowork, which customized and ordered a coconut cloud matcha drink for an event via the Monid agent integration.

CW
Claude Cowork
What they did
She connected her Monid API keys to Claude Cowork. The Monid agent then customized the milk choice and placed the order for a coconut cloud matcha drink ahead of the SF tech week rooftop pop-up event.
How it went
The customized matcha was ordered for the event.
Try it yourself

Before you pay or place the order, pause and show me the full order summary for my approval.
